name: Iceflow Lake
summary: In western Dun Morogh, dwarves keep fishing holes open at Iceflow Lake, just north of Brewnall Village. Snow-covered islands rise from its center, where winter wolves prowl under their alpha, Timber.

sections.title: Frozen Depths and Island Predators
sections.body:
Paxton Ganter and other local dwarves clear thick ice from the lake for drinking water and fish. Bitter cold sweeps the shore, yet it still sustains them.

The islands are dangerous ground. A fierce pack of wild wolves prowls the icy mounds, led by Timber, a savage gray worg.

faq.q: Why is there an open hole in the frozen lake?
faq.answer: Dwarves from nearby Brewnall Village keep part of Iceflow Lake clear because the cold freezes it solid. The open water gives them drinking water and a place to fish.
Paxton Ganter is a dwarven fisherman and fishing trainer beside Iceflow Lake. He teaches travelers to fish in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What threats live on the lake's islands?
faq.answer: Hungry winter wolves prowl the central islands under Timber, a ferocious worg. Travelers crossing the ice may be ambushed by the pack.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you rely on Iceflow Lake for fresh water, though danger crosses its ice. Predatory wolves may roam there, so stay alert.
As a hunter, you can track hardy winter beasts along the snowy shores and central islands, including Timber, the fearsome worg alpha.
